title: Cliffside Glass Greenhouse
creator: Marissaemmaa
summary: A glowing glass greenhouse perched on a terraced cliffside garden, wrapped in vines, string lights, fences, and small planted paths.
publicNotes:
## Build notes

This compact greenhouse uses glass walls and a skylight roof to turn the interior lighting into the focal point. String lights soften the structure, while vines, flower beds, wooden fencing, and layered paths connect it naturally to the surrounding cliffside garden.
